rationale: Current ES 8.8 Premier aggregate lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The detailed 8.8 Cloud guide lists Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, assistant enablement, paired SOAR, permissions and at least one already triaged finding. Existing findings, first-ten burst and daily tenant limits remain task-scoped. Cloud Connected CMP separately lists Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The 8.7 task retains historical Cloud scope. The current ES 8.8 release page gives November 4 GA and omits the exact historical Controlled Availability section. Edition tables and limited IL2 base-assistant evidence establish neither exact pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement nor customer authorization.

deployments: Premier Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP
exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.

remainingConcerns: Independently reconcile the missing mapped SOC Controlled Availability section, the native result for this exact attempt and production delivery evidence. Review by November 12.
